transcript.en: Hello, English learners, and welcome to another great podcast with EnglishPod.
transcript.zh: 大家好，英语学习者们，欢迎来到 EnglishPod 的又一期精彩播客。

transcript.en: And today we have another really great lesson for you, elementary lesson.
transcript.zh: 今天我们为大家准备了另一节非常棒的课程，初级课程。

transcript.en: That's right, and it's another lesson about money.
transcript.zh: 没错，而且是另一节关于钱的课程。

transcript.en: We have no money here at EnglishPod.
transcript.zh: 我们在 EnglishPod 这里没钱。

transcript.en: If I owe you money, I'm in debt.
transcript.zh: 如果我欠你钱，我就负债了。

transcript.en: In fact, I think I am in debt to you.
transcript.zh: 事实上，我想我现在就欠你钱。

transcript.en: You owe me $2.50 for a Coke Zero today.
transcript.zh: 你今天欠我两块五的零度可乐钱。

transcript.en: Let's take a look at our vocabulary preview.
transcript.zh: 让我们来看看词汇预览。

transcript.en: We have two words today in our vocabulary preview, and the first one is recession.
transcript.zh: 今天的词汇预览有两个词，第一个是 recession（经济衰退）。

transcript.en: Everyone's talking about it right now, and what does it mean?
transcript.zh: 现在人人都在谈论它，那它是什么意思呢？

transcript.en: Why don't you tell me, Erica, because this isn't my topic for today.
transcript.zh: 艾瑞卡，你来告诉我吧，因为今天这不是我的主题。

transcript.en: Recession is a period of time when the economy of a country is doing badly.
transcript.zh: Recession 是一个国家经济表现糟糕的时期。

transcript.en: In a recession, the country is making less money.
transcript.zh: 在经济衰退中，国家的收入减少。

transcript.en: Maybe we can give a few examples of things that happen in a recession to show the meaning of this a little bit better.
transcript.zh: 也许我们可以举几个经济衰退中会发生的事情的例子，来更好地说明这个词的意思。

transcript.en: So, for example, in a recession, many people lose their jobs.
transcript.zh: 比如，在经济衰退中，很多人失去工作。

transcript.en: Because companies might close or go bankrupt.
transcript.zh: 因为公司可能会倒闭或破产。

transcript.en: And also, people start spending less money.
transcript.zh: 而且，人们开始减少消费。

transcript.en: And the stock prices of companies fall.
Yeah, they fall a lot, hey?
That's what's going on now in the United States.
transcript.zh: 这就是美国现在正在发生的情况。

transcript.en: So, let's take a look at our second word, and it has to do with recession.
transcript.zh: 那么，让我们看第二个词，它和经济衰退有关。

transcript.en: It means that you have no money.
So, these are our two words for vocabulary preview today, and you're going to hear them in the dialogue.
transcript.zh: 这就是今天词汇预览的两个词，你将在对话中听到它们。

transcript.en: This dialogue is about a man who is in debt.
transcript.zh: 这段对话是关于一个负债的男人。
让我们来看看发生了什么。

transcript.en: I'm here to see Mr. Corleone.
Charlie, what can I do for you?
Mr. Corleone, I'm really sorry to trouble you, but I need your help.
transcript.zh: 科莱昂先生，真的很抱歉打扰您，但我需要您的帮助。

transcript.en: Your father was like a brother to me.
transcript.zh: 你父亲对我来说就像兄弟一样。

transcript.en: Well, sir, you see, this recession has hit me pretty hard.
transcript.zh: 嗯，先生，您看，这次经济衰退对我打击很大。

transcript.en: I lost my job, and I'm in a lot of debt.
transcript.zh: 我丢了工作，还欠了很多债。

transcript.en: Yeah, you know, I've got credit card bills, car payments, I've got to pay my mortgage,
transcript.zh: 是的，您知道，我有信用卡账单、汽车贷款，我还得付房贷，

transcript.en: and on top of all that, I have to pay my son's college tuition.
transcript.zh: 除此之外，我还得付我儿子的大学学费。

transcript.en: So you're asking for a loan.
Well, I just thought maybe you could help me out.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我只是想也许您能帮我一把。

transcript.en: You're not the only one who's been hit by the recession.
transcript.zh: 你不是唯一被经济衰退打击的人。

transcript.en: I lost half my money in the stock market crash.
transcript.zh: 我在股市崩盘中损失了一半的钱。

transcript.en: Okay, so that was a bit unexpected.
He didn't go to the bank to ask for money, did he?
No, he went to the mob, and the mob is broke.
transcript.zh: 没有，他去找了黑帮，而黑帮也没钱了。

transcript.en: Oh no, you know it's a bad recession when even the mob runs out of money.
transcript.zh: 天哪，连黑帮都没钱了，这经济衰退可真严重。

transcript.en: All right, so why don't we start by looking at our language takeaway.
transcript.zh: 好了，我们来看看语言要点吧。

transcript.en: All right, so for today's language takeaway, we have four words from the dialogue which we think are really important.
transcript.zh: 好的，今天的语言要点，我们有对话中的四个词，我们认为它们非常重要。

transcript.en: Yes, so why don't we start with the first one?
transcript.zh: 是的，那从第一个开始吧？

transcript.en: So, Erika, tell us about a loan.
transcript.zh: 艾瑞卡，给我们讲讲 loan。

transcript.en: Okay, when you borrow money, you get a loan.
transcript.zh: 好的，当你借钱的时候，你就获得了一笔贷款。

transcript.en: Not to be confused with alone, like by myself.
transcript.zh: 不要和 alone（独自一人）混淆。

transcript.en: Let's take a look at our second word, mortgage.
transcript.zh: 让我们看第二个词——mortgage（房贷/抵押贷款）。

transcript.en: I'm sure many of you have mortgages.
transcript.zh: 我相信你们很多人都有房贷。

transcript.en: A mortgage is a type of a loan.
Basically, it's a loan that helps you to buy a house.
transcript.zh: 基本上，它是一种帮你买房的贷款。

transcript.en: Yeah, so this is a funny word.
transcript.zh: 是的，这是一个有趣的词。

transcript.en: I mean, there's this strange mortgage with a T.
transcript.zh: 我的意思是，这个词里有个奇怪的 T。

transcript.en: Yeah, it has a T in it, but you don't pronounce it.
transcript.zh: 对，里面有个 T，但你不发音。

transcript.en: I had trouble spelling that one for this lesson, so I learned it well now.
transcript.zh: 我为了这节课拼这个词遇到了困难，所以现在学得很好了。

transcript.en: Let's move to our third word today.
transcript.zh: 我们来看今天的第三个词。
Hit me pretty hard（对我打击很大）。

transcript.en: I think we have some examples that will help us understand this phrase.
transcript.zh: 我想我们有一些例子可以帮助我们理解这个短语。

transcript.en: My divorce hit me pretty hard.
This cold has hit me pretty hard.
transcript.zh: 这次感冒把我折腾得不轻。

transcript.en: I've been in bed for a week.
The news of Fluffy's death hit me pretty hard.
transcript.zh: 毛毛去世的消息对我打击很大。

transcript.en: Okay, so that's a lot clearer.
Why don't we take a look at our last word for language takeaway?
transcript.zh: 我们来看看语言要点的最后一个词吧？

transcript.en: So this is the money you have to pay to your school so that you can study there.
transcript.zh: 这是你必须付给学校才能在那里学习的钱。

transcript.en: Usually, it's in college, right, or university.
Yeah, but sometimes in some countries, you have to pay tuition for public school.
transcript.zh: 是的，但有时候在一些国家，公立学校也要交学费。

transcript.en: So it's time to listen to our dialogue again, and it's going to be slower so we can listen to all the words that we just talked about.
transcript.zh: 现在再听一遍对话，这次会慢一些，这样我们就能听到刚刚讨论过的所有词汇。

transcript.en: I'm here to see Mr. Corleone.
Charlie, what can I do for you?
Mr. Corleone, I'm really sorry to trouble you, but I need your help.
transcript.zh: 科莱昂先生，真的很抱歉打扰您，但我需要您的帮助。

transcript.en: Your father was like a brother to me.
transcript.zh: 你父亲对我来说就像兄弟一样。

transcript.en: Well, sir, you see, this recession has hit me pretty hard.
transcript.zh: 嗯，先生，您看，这次经济衰退对我打击很大。

transcript.en: I lost my job, and I'm in a lot of debt.
transcript.zh: 我丢了工作，还欠了很多债。

transcript.en: You know, I've got credit card bills, car payments, I've got to pay my mortgage, and on top of all that, I have to pay my son's college tuition.
transcript.zh: 您知道，我有信用卡账单、汽车贷款，我得付房贷，除此之外，我还得付我儿子的大学学费。

transcript.en: So you're asking for a loan.
Well, I just thought maybe you could help me out.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我只是想也许您能帮我一把。

transcript.en: You're not the only one who has been hit by the recession.
transcript.zh: 你不是唯一被经济衰退打击的人。

transcript.en: I lost half my money in the stock market crash.
transcript.zh: 我在股市崩盘中损失了一半的钱。

transcript.en: Go on, get out of here.
Okay, so I think a lot of the key language we just talked about is a lot more clear now.
transcript.zh: 好的，我想我们刚刚讨论的很多关键语言现在清楚多了。

transcript.en: But you know, I also noticed some really interesting phrases in this dialogue.
transcript.zh: 但你知道吗，我还注意到这段对话中有些非常有趣的短语。

transcript.en: So let's start with Fluency Builder.
transcript.zh: 所以我们开始流利表达吧。

transcript.en: Fluency Builder is a tool that we use to help you sound more native.
transcript.zh: 流利表达是我们用来帮助你说得更像母语者的工具。

transcript.en: Right, so you can sound more natural when you're speaking.
transcript.zh: 对，这样你说话时就能听起来更自然。

transcript.en: So we take a really common phrase, and we show you some great natural ways of expressing that same idea.
transcript.zh: 我们选取一个非常常用的短语，然后教你一些表达同样意思的很棒的自然说法。

transcript.en: And today we have three of these examples.
transcript.zh: 今天我们有三个这样的例子。

transcript.en: Let's start with the first one.
So this phrase we use when we want to ask somebody, can I help you?
transcript.zh: 这个短语在我们想问某人「我能帮你吗？」时使用。

transcript.en: What can I do for you?
transcript.zh: What can I do for you？（我能为你做什么？）

transcript.en: What can I do for you?
transcript.zh: What can I do for you？

transcript.en: Yeah, that sounds really, really polite and really natural.
transcript.zh: 是的，这听起来非常非常有礼貌，也非常自然。

transcript.en: Right, so instead of saying, can I help you?
transcript.zh: 对，所以与其说 can I help you？

transcript.en: Or, I don't know, what do you need?
transcript.zh: 或者说，我不知道，what do you need？

transcript.en: We can just say, what can I do for you?
transcript.zh: 我们可以直接说 what can I do for you？

transcript.en: So let's move to our second phrase.
This phrase we use when we need something, when we want to say, I'm sorry to bother you.
transcript.zh: 这个短语在我们需要某物、想说「对不起打扰你了」时使用。
或者说「对不起打断一下。」

transcript.en: I'm really sorry to trouble you.
transcript.zh: I'm really sorry to trouble you（真的很抱歉打扰你）。

transcript.en: I'm really sorry to trouble you.
transcript.zh: I'm really sorry to trouble you.

transcript.en: This phrase might be a little bit more difficult to understand how it's used, but we've got some examples.
transcript.zh: 这个短语的用法可能稍微难理解一些，但我们有一些例子。

transcript.en: Can I trouble you for a moment?
I just need you to sign this form for me.
transcript.zh: 我只需要你帮我签一下这份表格。

transcript.en: I'm sorry to trouble you, but may I go home early today?
transcript.zh: 很抱歉打扰你，但我今天能早点回家吗？

transcript.en: Can I trouble you for a pen?
transcript.zh: 能麻烦你借我一支笔吗？

transcript.en: Okay, so now let's take a look at our last phrase for fluency builder.
transcript.zh: 好的，现在看流利表达的最后一个短语。
On top of all that（除此之外/更糟糕的是）。

transcript.en: This is a really useful phrase.
transcript.zh: 这是一个非常有用的短语。

transcript.en: Marco, how would you use it?
Well, for example, today I lost my job.
transcript.zh: 嗯，比如，今天我丢了工作。

transcript.en: And on top of all that, my girlfriend broke up with me.
transcript.zh: 更糟糕的是，我女朋友跟我分手了。

transcript.en: You can use this phrase also in a positive way.
transcript.zh: 你也可以用这个短语来表达正面的意思。

transcript.en: You could say, so today was a really great day.
transcript.zh: 你可以说，今天真是美好的一天。

transcript.en: It was my birthday and all my friends came to visit me and on top of all that, I got a million presents.
transcript.zh: 是我的生日，所有朋友都来看我，最重要的是，我收到了无数礼物。

transcript.en: So you can use on top of all that in this way.
transcript.zh: 所以你可以这样用 on top of all that。

transcript.en: So on top of all that.
transcript.zh: 所以 on top of all that。

transcript.en: So we are ready to listen to our dialogue a third time.
transcript.zh: 现在我们准备听第三遍对话。

transcript.en: We can hear all the words that we just talked about and all the phrases and you'll definitely be able to understand a lot better now.
transcript.zh: 我们能听到刚刚讨论过的所有词汇和短语，你现在一定能理解得好得多了。

transcript.en: I'm here to see Mr. Corleone.
Charlie, what can I do for you?
Mr. Corleone, I'm really sorry to trouble you, but I need your help.
transcript.zh: 科莱昂先生，真的很抱歉打扰您，但我需要您的帮助。

transcript.en: Your father was like a brother to me.
transcript.zh: 你父亲对我来说就像兄弟一样。

transcript.en: Well, sir, you see, this recession has hit me pretty hard.
transcript.zh: 嗯，先生，您看，这次经济衰退对我打击很大。

transcript.en: I lost my job and I'm in a lot of debt.
transcript.zh: 我丢了工作，还欠了很多债。

transcript.en: Yeah, you know, I've got credit card bills, car payments.
transcript.zh: 是的，您知道，我有信用卡账单、汽车贷款。

transcript.en: I've got to pay my mortgage.
And on top of all that, I have to pay my son's college tuition.
transcript.zh: 除此之外，我还得付我儿子的大学学费。

transcript.en: So you're asking for a loan.
Well, I just thought maybe you could help me out.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我只是想也许您能帮我一把。

transcript.en: You're not the only one who's been hit by the recession.
transcript.zh: 你不是唯一被经济衰退打击的人。

transcript.en: I lost half my money in the stock market crash.
transcript.zh: 我在股市崩盘中损失了一半的钱。

transcript.en: Today's dialogue was all about being in debt, right?
transcript.zh: 今天的对话全是关于负债的，对吧？

transcript.en: And, and different people have different attitudes or different viewpoints on being in debt.
transcript.zh: 而且，不同的人对负债有不同的态度或观点。

transcript.en: For example, in North America and in Canada, it's a really common thing.
transcript.zh: 比如，在北美和加拿大，这是非常普遍的事情。

transcript.en: Yeah, it's actually almost good to be in debt.
transcript.zh: 是的，负债实际上几乎是一件好事。

transcript.en: It's necessary to be in debt.
Unless you have a history of being in debt and regularly paying off your debts, you can't actually borrow money.
transcript.zh: 除非你有负债并按时还清的历史，否则你实际上借不到钱。

transcript.en: You can't get a car loan so you can buy a new car.
transcript.zh: 你拿不到车贷去买新车。

transcript.en: So you must have a good credit history in order to be able to, like you say, buy a car or buy a house.
transcript.zh: 所以你必须有一个良好的信用记录，才能像你说的那样买车或买房。

transcript.en: And you know, the funny thing is, when I was in university, maybe I was 18 years old, the first thing that happened at university was, you know, banks came to our university and
transcript.zh: 你知道吗，有趣的是，我上大学的时候，大概18岁，在大学发生的第一件事就是银行来到我们学校，

transcript.en: So you can get a credit card when you're 18, no problem.
transcript.zh: 所以你18岁就能拿到信用卡，完全没问题。

transcript.en: And not only do they offer you credit cards, they give you like free gifts if you sign up for a credit card.
transcript.zh: 他们不只给你提供信用卡，如果你办卡的话他们还会送你免费礼品。

transcript.en: So they really want you to have a credit card.
transcript.zh: 所以他们真的想让你拥有信用卡。

transcript.en: Of course, they want you to spend more money.
transcript.zh: 当然，他们想让你花更多的钱。

transcript.en: It's totally different in Europe, for example.
transcript.zh: 比如说，在欧洲就完全不同。

transcript.en: I used to live in Switzerland and there, they're really careful with debt.
transcript.zh: 我以前住在瑞士，那里的人对债务非常谨慎。

transcript.en: Like it's a bad thing to be in debt.
transcript.zh: 在那里负债是一件坏事。

transcript.en: I mean, it's bad to be in debt.
transcript.zh: 我的意思是，负债确实不好。

transcript.en: For example, if I want to have a credit card in Switzerland and let's say I want to have a limit of 500 francs that I can spend every month.
transcript.zh: 比如，如果我想在瑞士拥有一张信用卡，假设我想要每月500法郎的额度。

transcript.en: I need to put in my bank account 700 francs before I can even spend that credit card money.
transcript.zh: 我必须先在银行账户里存入700法郎，然后才能花那张信用卡的钱。

transcript.en: So it's totally opposite from North America.
I mean, in North America, it's crazy the way that people are in debt and it's showing now with the recession, right?
transcript.zh: 我的意思是，在北美，人们负债的方式太疯狂了，现在随着经济衰退就显现出来了，对吧？

transcript.en: So everyone, be sure to handle your money carefully.
transcript.zh: 所以各位，一定要谨慎理财。

transcript.en: Don't be in debt unless you really, really have to.
transcript.zh: 除非万不得已，不要负债。
来自 EnglishPod 的理财好建议。

transcript.en: Now, remember, if you have any questions or comments, please visit our website at EnglishPod.com.
transcript.zh: 记住，如果你有任何问题或评论，请访问我们的网站 EnglishPod.com。

transcript.en: Erika and I are always there to answer all the questions and we really like to receive comments and suggestions from all our users.
transcript.zh: 艾瑞卡和我总是在那里回答所有问题，我们也非常喜欢收到用户的评论和建议。

transcript.en: So be sure to go and leave us your comments.
transcript.zh: 所以一定要去给我们留下评论。

transcript.en: But sadly, we have to go now.
transcript.zh: 但遗憾的是，我们现在得走了。

dialogue.en: A: Hello, I'm here to see Mr. Corleone.
dialogue.zh: A：你好，我是来见科尔莱昂先生的。

dialogue.en: C: What can I do for you?
B: Mr. Corlone, I'm really sorry to trouble you, but I need your help.
dialogue.zh: B：科尔莱昂先生，真的很抱歉打扰您，但我需要您的帮助。

dialogue.en: C: Your father was like a brother to me.
dialogue.zh: C：你父亲就像我的亲兄弟一样。

dialogue.en: B: Well, sir, you see, this recession has hit me pretty hard; I lost my job and I'm in a lot of debt.
dialogue.zh: B：嗯，先生，您知道的，这次经济衰退对我打击很大；我丢了工作，还欠了很多债。

dialogue.en: B: Yeah, you know, I've got credit card bills, car payments, I've got to pay my mortgage; and on top of all that, I have to pay my son's college tuition.
dialogue.zh: B：是啊，你看，我有信用卡账单、汽车贷款，还得还房贷；除此之外，我还得付我儿子的大学学费。

dialogue.en: C: So you're asking for a loan.
B: Well, I just thought maybe you could help me out.
dialogue.zh: B：嗯，我只是想也许您能帮我一把。

dialogue.en: C: At a time like this?
C: I'm broke too, you know!
C: You're not the only one who has been hit by the recession!
dialogue.zh: C：不是只有你一个人受到了经济衰退的打击！

dialogue.en: C: I lost half my money in the stock market crash!
dialogue.zh: C：我在股市崩盘中损失了一半的钱！
